row.evidence: BugSnag's pricing page lists "Automatic user provisioning via SSO" only under Enterprise ("Contact Us"), with SAML single sign-on from Preferred, and the SSO docs say "Provisioning and deprovisioning is available on Enterprise plans."
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated). Prices changed: the pricing page (Billed Yearly toggle selected) now shows Select from $20/month and Preferred from $33/month, versus June's ~$23 and ~$39 (June's billing basis is unrecorded). Plans are priced by event and span volume with unlimited users, so per-user fields stay null. SAML SSO (with JIT 'Auto-provision collaborators') is on Preferred; SCIM 2.0 user and group provisioning is Enterprise-only. SCIM deactivation removes the collaborator from the organization but keeps their BugSnag user record so they can be re-added. SCIM is not supported for the BugSnag for Enterprise instance via the OneLogin app. The Data Access API (collaborators, teams) is on all paid plans (low volume on Select).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user, 7.5K events and 1M spans per month.

plans.name: Select
plans.notes: Event-volume priced (50k to 3M monthly events), unlimited users; Data export API at low volume. Price is rendered client-side (static HTML shows a $0 placeholder); quote verified in the headless render.

plans.name: Preferred
plans.notes: SAML SSO with JIT auto-provisioning; no SCIM. Price is rendered client-side (static HTML shows a $0 placeholder); quote verified in the headless render.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: User audit logs are Enterprise-only in the UI; no audit-log endpoint was found in the Data Access API.

auth.token_source: User settings > Personal auth tokens of an organization administrator; SCIM Base URL from Organization settings > Single sign-on
auth.notes: The SCIM credential is an admin's personal auth token; the Data Access API spec documents the 'token' Authorization prefix.

endpoints.notes: Only /Users and /Groups appear in the published API spec.

deprovision.data_retained: The collaborator is removed from the organization but their BugSnag user record is kept, so they can be re-added with the same ID.

roles.how: Not via SCIM attributes; SCIM groups map to BugSnag teams, which carry project access.

limitations.text: PATCH /Users only supports replacing 'active'; name and email changes need PUT.
Filtering supports only userName eq (Users) and displayName eq (Groups).
Creating a group does not add members; membership must be added with a group PATCH.
SCIM is not supported for organizations on the BugSnag for Enterprise instance using the OneLogin app.
SCIM calls return 403 'SCIM not enabled' when the organization does not have SCIM.
JIT/SSO provisioning only adds users up to the plan's collaborator limit.

auth.notes: Organization-level auth tokens are deprecated in favour of user-level personal auth tokens.

capabilities.notes: Update sets project access, project roles (project_owner/project_member) and the admin flag. 'Groups' are BugSnag teams.

endpoints.purpose: List all collaborators that are members of your organization
Invite a collaborator to your organization
Bulk invite collaborators to your organization
Show a Collaborator on an Organization
Show the details of a team
List the Collaborators in a Team

audit_log_api.notes: User audit logs are an Enterprise UI feature; the Data Access API spec has no audit-log endpoint.

limitations.text: The pricing page rates the Data export API 'Low volume' on Select and 'High volume' on Preferred and Enterprise.

okta.notes: The 'Bugsnag SAML' OIN app has SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push checked (read from page markup). A separate older 'Bugsnag' OIN app is SWA-only.

entra.notes: Microsoft's tutorial covers SAML SSO and JIT only; no Entra provisioning tutorial found.

google.notes: BugSnag documents a Google Cloud Identity SAML setup; catalogue not checked.

onelogin.notes: From BugSnag's own OneLogin guide; OneLogin's connector page was not loaded.
